entities.summary: Evgeny Alexandrovich Ryasensky, or Yevgeni Ryasenski, is a Russian professional ice hockey defenceman who is an unrestricted free agent. He most recently played for Neftekhimik Nizhnekamsk of the Kontinental Hockey League (KHL).
